Resolve point-events argument for hc_add_series

Source: R/geoms.R
point_events_or_null.Rd

Returns the hover-band events list when use_js = TRUE, or NULL when use_js = FALSE. Passing NULL omits the point key entirely from the series options, which keeps the Highcharts tooltip intact. Passing an empty list() instead of NULL causes shared tooltips to stop working because highcharter serialises it as an empty JS object that Highcharts interprets as an override, suppressing default tooltip behaviour.

Usage

point_events_or_null(use_js)
